file_sync_protocol.rule: Before updating, AI MUST first re-read the raw version.

github_raw_cache_protocol.rule: raw.githubusercontent.com has CDN delay (5-10 min). Check locally via git log first.

external_ai_sync_rule.rule: External AI does not read files silently by guessing. It requests content via GitHub API (bypasses CDN cache). Gardener simply copies the link into chat.
external_ai_sync_rule.why: GitHub API returns the actual version without CDN delay + Gardener does not need to copy file contents.
external_ai_sync_rule.hard_rule: STRICT LIMIT: Maximum 1 API link per request. Request files one by one to avoid truncated responses.
workflow: 1. AI identifies required file in honeycombs/
2. AI forms API link and sends to Gardener (1 link per request)
3. Gardener copies link and pastes into chat
4. System retrieves content from API and works with actual version

copyable_links.rule: When providing URLs, ALWAYS wrap them in a code block with 'text' language (```text ... ```). This ensures the 'Copy' button appears in the interface.

powershell_command_rules.description: How to form perfect PowerShell commands that Gardener can copy-paste.
rules: ALWAYS provide exactly ONE complete command. Use semicolons (;) to chain multiple actions.
Include 'git pull' at the start of any modifying command.
Include 'git add', 'git commit', and 'git push' inside the SAME command.
Use '@' ... '@' for multi-line JSON content, piped to Out-File with -Encoding utf8.
powershell_command_rules.example_delete_file: Remove-Item 'path/to/file.json'; git add -A; git commit -m 'chore: delete'; git push
powershell_command_rules.example_move_file: Move-Item 'old/path' 'new/path'; git add -A; git commit -m 'refactor: move'; git push
